proof_body:
by
  intro Ω _ P _ X a b hab hX hU
  have hba : 0 < b - a := by linarith
  have hk : ∀ g : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous g → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => g (X ω)) P ∧ ∫ ω, g (X ω) ∂P = (b - a)⁻¹ * ∫ x in a..b, g x := by
    intro g hg
    have hc : ProbabilityTheory.cond MeasureTheory.volume (Set.Icc a b) = (ENNReal.ofReal (b - a))⁻¹ • MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc a b) := by
      rw [ProbabilityTheory.cond, Real.volume_Icc]
    constructor
    · have h1 : MeasureTheory.Integrable g (P.map X) := by
        rw [hU, hc]
        refine MeasureTheory.Integrable.smul_measure (hg.integrableOn_Icc) ?_
        simp [hab]
      exact (MeasureTheory.integrable_map_measure hg.aestronglyMeasurable hX.aemeasurable).mp h1 |>.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun _ => rfl)
    · have h2 : ∫ ω, g (X ω) ∂P = ∫ x, g x ∂(P.map X) := (MeasureTheory.integral_map hX.aemeasurable hg.aestronglyMeasurable).symm
      rw [h2, hU, hc, MeasureTheory.integral_smul_measure, intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hab.le, MeasureTheory.integral_Icc_eq_integral_Ioc, ENNReal.toReal_inv, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hba.le, smul_eq_mul]
  obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hk (fun x => x) continuous_id
  obtain ⟨h3, h4⟩ := hk (fun x => x ^ 2) (continuous_pow 2)
  have hm : ∫ ω, X ω ∂P = (a + b) / 2 := by
    rw [h2, integral_id]; field_simp; ring
  refine ⟨hm, ?_⟩
  have hL : MeasureTheory.MemLp X 2 P := (MeasureTheory.memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq hX.aestronglyMeasurable).mpr h3
  rw [ProbabilityTheory.variance_eq_sub hL]
  simp only [Pi.pow_apply]
  rw [hm, h4, integral_pow]
  field_simp
  ring
target_source: ∀ (Ω : Type*) [MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] (X : Ω → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a < b → Measurable X → MeasureTheory.pdf.IsUniform X (Set.Icc a b) P → ∫ ω, X ω ∂P = (a + b) / 2 ∧ ProbabilityTheory.variance X P = (b - a) ^ 2 / 12
